grh_7ffcc2dbbf0563b6ac31.title: Apartment in Athens
paragraphs: In occupied Athens, Nicholas Helianos deliberately takes a German officer, Captain Kalter, into his family home in hopes that apparent cooperation will protect them. The arrangement humiliates his wife Zoe and son Alex, while Kalter dominates the household and the family learns how dangerous even small acts of resistance can be. After a trip home, Kalter returns shattered by the deaths of his wife and son. Nicholas briefly sympathizes with him, then condemns the leaders who caused both Greek and German suffering. Kalter responds by summoning the military police. Facing execution, Nicholas sends Alex to join relatives in the mountains and leaves him one final lesson: never trust the occupier.

grh_7fedb17d338c41167e4d.title: The Odyssey of Number Fourteen
paragraphs: A reporter investigates the secret disappearance of astronaut Ted Shaw after an unexplained launch. Officials finally reveal that Shaw was sent through the Plickin radiation field, whose strange sound effects produced a kind of audio hypnosis that made him desperate to remain in orbit. Ground controllers had secretly locked him out of manual control and forced the capsule back to Earth, after which he withdrew into near-catatonia. Shaw's wife joins his rehabilitation and patiently uses familiar speech and coordination exercises until he begins responding again.
